note: Motion by interaction. ms gives [calm, standard, expressive] durations; null means the tier does not use it. animate lists the only properties that should change. reduced is what replaces the motion when the user asks for reduced motion. Exits run at roughly two thirds of the entry duration.

motion.name: Press and hover feedback
motion.rule: feedback starts within 100ms of the input; never move neighbouring content

motion.name: Toggle, checkbox and tab switch
motion.reduced: instant state change with the colour change kept
motion.rule: the new state is readable without the animation; motion only connects old and new

motion.name: Dialog, sheet and popover entry
motion.rule: the trigger and the overlay are spatially linked; exit runs faster than entry

motion.name: Dialog, sheet and popover exit
motion.rule: focus returns to the element that opened the overlay

motion.name: Toast and inline notice
motion.rule: stays at least 5s, pauses on hover and focus, and is announced politely

motion.name: Route or screen change
animate: transform: shared element or short slide
motion.rule: navigation is never blocked while the transition runs; back reverses the direction

motion.name: List or grid entrance
motion.rule: stagger step 20-40ms and the whole group finishes within 500ms; only the first screen of items staggers

motion.name: Scroll-linked reveal
motion.reduced: content shown in its final state; parallax removed
motion.rule: content is readable before and without the effect; never hijack scroll speed

motion.name: Loading and skeletons
motion.reduced: static skeleton with a text status
motion.rule: show nothing for the first 300ms to avoid flashes; skeletons match the final layout

motion.name: Live data and number changes
animate: chart path for the first render only
motion.rule: never animate values that change more than once a second; announce changes that matter, not every tick

motion.name: Success and celebration moment
motion.reduced: static badge or check mark with the message
motion.rule: reserved for real milestones, at most once per session, never during a task

motion.name: Drag, reorder and swipe
motion.reduced: item moves without the settle animation
motion.rule: the item follows the pointer with no lag; a button or menu offers the same action
